1. HeroSection (default left) 2. AnatomySection — 3 MoatCardBright-style cards in row, with white bg, 3px top accent strip, icon, title, body, detail rows 3. ScreenshotSection — PhotoBand visual (480 height) OR custom mockup card 4. ProofSection — StatStrip with 4 metrics OR customer quote 5. FAQAccordion — 4-5 feature-specific questions 6. CTASection — closing
``` **No `any`. Strict types. CTAs ``. signupUrl = `https://inkos.up.railway.app/signup`. Reference style for accent cards: read `src/components/home/work.tsx` MoatCardBright pattern. Each row: flex justify space-between, padding 10px 0, dashed accent borderBottom (none on last). Label 11.5px 500 stoneDark. Value 12px 600 onyx textAlign right. - whileHover y:-4 + boxShadow SHADOW.card - Use ACCENT_MAP from `@/lib/brand` --- ## PAGE 1: `src/app/product/clients/page.tsx` — Clients **Metadata:** title: "Clients — CRM with allergy intelligence and photo histories | InkOS" description: "Every client. Every session. Every contraindication. Photos, consent, allergy, comms — one record, surfaced when it matters." **Hero:** ```tsx ``` **Anatomy section** (GRADIENT.sectionWarm, SectionEyebrow "What's on the record" accent="amber" + h2 "Three columns of intel."): 1. (rust, AlertCircle) "Allergy intelligence" — "Red ink, latex, topical reactions — all linked to the client. Surfaces on Today, on the schedule card, in the artist's brief. Never buried." Detail: [Surfaces in: 4 places] [Patch test log: ON] [Last updated: visible] 2. (amber, ImageIcon) "Photo timeline" — "Every session has its photos: reference, fresh, healing, healed. Auto-organised by project, accessible from the client record." Detail: [Stages tracked: 4] [Storage: Supabase] [Auto-tag: by session] 3. (sage, MessageSquare) "Comms thread" — "Every SMS, email, and IG DM lives on the client record. Last touch surfaces on Today. Internal notes vs client-facing — clearly separated." Detail: [Channels: 4] [Internal notes: YES] [Auto-archive: 90d] **Visual**: PhotoBand height 420, gradient `linear-gradient(135deg, ${BRAND.rust} 0%, ${BRAND.amber} 100%)`, label "Client profile · Asha Mehra · Koi sleeve project · 4 sessions" **Stats:** ```tsx ``` **FAQ (4):** - "Can I export a single client's full record?" — "Yes. PDF export pulls every session, photo, consent, communication, and allergy field for one client. GDPR Article 15 ready." - "How does allergy data get into the system?" — "Three ways: artist input, client kiosk form, ongoing chair updates. Every change is timestamped and audit-logged." - "Do photos count against any storage limit?" — "No. Photo storage is unlimited on every paid plan." - "Can a guest artist see clients I've worked with?" — "Only if you grant access. Default is per-artist scoping. Studio owners see all." **CTA:** ```tsx ``` --- ## PAGE 2: `src/app/product/forms/page.tsx` — Forms **Metadata:** title: "Forms — Kiosk consent, REACH waivers, audit trail | InkOS" description: "Digital consent forms. Tablet kiosk. EU REACH waivers. PDF audit trail with hash signatures. The paperwork, finally not paperwork." **Hero:** ```tsx ``` **Anatomy** (GRADIENT.sectionCool, SectionEyebrow "What's in the file" accent="sage" + h2 "Three workflows. One kiosk."): 1. (rust, FileText) "Tablet kiosk mode" — "Hand the iPad to the client. Their booking auto-loads. Consent, waivers, allergy update — submitted before they sit. No clipboard." 2. (amber, Shield) "REACH-compliant waivers" — "EU 2022 ink registry baked in. Every red-ink reaction is tied to a CI number. Every waiver references the ink batch. Inspector-ready." 3. (sage, CheckCircle2) "Hashed PDF audit trail" — "Every submission produces a PDF with a SHA-256 hash. Stored in Supabase, never editable, court-admissible. Three years' retention by default." **Visual:** PhotoBand height 420, gradient `linear-gradient(135deg, ${BRAND.amber} 0%, ${BRAND.sage} 100%)`, label "Kiosk mode · iPad in studio · client filling consent" **Stats:** ```tsx ``` **FAQ:** - "Can I customise the consent form?" — "Yes. Drag-drop builder for fields, sections, signature blocks. Studio-branded with your logo and colours." - "Are submissions e-signable in my country?" — "Yes. eIDAS-compliant in the EU, ESIGN-compliant in the US. Hashed audit trail makes them court-admissible." - "What happens to the data after the appointment?" — "Stored on the client record. PDF archived. Retention policy set per studio (default 3 years)." - "Can clients fill the form before they arrive?" — "Yes. Forms send by SMS or email link the day before. Pre-filled when client arrives." - "Does it support photo upload (e.g. ID verification)?" — "Yes. Forms can require photo capture (ID, fitness-to-tattoo doc). Stored alongside the PDF." **CTA:** badge "Paperwork, gone" / headline "Consent in 90 seconds." / italicWord "seconds" / subhead "14-day trial. Set up the kiosk in five clicks. (rust, DollarSign) "Commission auto-splits" — "60/40, 70/30, custom per artist — the split routes to artist's Stripe Connect account on payment. The studio's cut lands in studio's account. Zero math." 2. (amber, Package) "Deposit pools" — "Apply $200 of a $600 deposit to S2. The rest carries to S3. Refund partial? The pool re-balances. Stripe handles the actual money." 3. (sage, BarChart3) "Payroll-ready" — "End of year: 1099-K (US), P11D (UK), MV (FR). Per-artist tax forms generated automatically from Stripe data. No CSV gymnastics." **Visual:** PhotoBand height 420, gradient `linear-gradient(135deg, ${BRAND.sage} 0%, ${BRAND.amber} 100%)`, label "Invoice with auto-split · Studio + Artist + Stripe fee" **Stats:** ```tsx ``` **FAQ:** - "Do you take a transaction fee?" — "Never. You pay the monthly software fee. Stripe takes its standard processing fee (2.9% + 30¢ in the US). InkOS takes nothing on top." - "Can I run payroll for W-2 artists, not just 1099?" — "Yes. Pro plan and above support hybrid models — auto-splits for contractors, plus payroll exports for W-2 artists." - "Does Stripe Connect work in my country?" — "47 countries. If Stripe is live where you are, InkOS is too." - "What about cash payments at the chair?" — "Logged manually. Reconciles against the day's bookings. Tax form treats it the same as card." **CTA:** badge "Cash that flows" / headline "Auto-pay your artists." / italicWord "Auto-pay" / subhead "14-day trial. Set up Stripe Connect once. Splits route on every invoice from then on." / primary signup / secondary `/book-a-demo` --- ## PAGE 4: `src/app/product/inventory/page.tsx` — Inventory **Metadata:** title: "Inventory — Ink registry, REACH compliance, low-stock alerts | InkOS" description: "Every ink, every needle, every batch. EU REACH 2022 compliance built in. Low-stock alerts. The cabinet, in software." **Hero:** ```tsx ``` **Anatomy:** 1. (rust, Shield) "REACH 2022 compliance" — "Every ink registered against the EU REACH ink registry. CI numbers, MSDS attachments, prohibited substances flagged. Inspector reports export in one click." 2. (amber, Package) "Stock + batch tracking" — "Bottles, batches, expiries. Every session deducts. Reorder triggers when below threshold. Vendor cost tracking on every line item." 3. (sage, AlertCircle) "Reaction logging" — "A client reacts to red ink? Log it on the client AND the bottle batch. Future studios using the same batch see the warning. Network-wide intelligence." **Visual:** PhotoBand height 420, gradient `linear-gradient(135deg, ${BRAND.amber} 0%, ${BRAND.rust} 100%)`, label "Ink registry · 84 bottles · 12 brands · REACH-compliant" **Stats:** ```tsx ``` **FAQ:** - "Do I need to be in the EU to use REACH features?" — "No. Studios in the US, UK, AU use it for the regulatory rigour. EU studios use it for legal compliance." - "Can I import my existing inventory list?" — "Yes. CSV import or copy-paste. Migration team helps map your bottles to REACH records on Studio plan and above." - "What about disposable items — needles, gloves, ink caps?" — "Tracked the same way. Per-session deduction logs how many of each were used." - "Can I track vendor costs and margins?" — "Yes. Cost-per-bottle on every line. Margin reports per artist, per session, per project." **CTA:** badge "The cabinet, finally tracked" / headline "Inventory, on the rails." / italicWord "rails" / subhead "14-day trial. Drop your ink list in. Watch REACH compliance light up." / primary signup / secondary `/book-a-demo` --- ## Implementation - Each page is a server component with `metadata` - Use motion.div for whileInView reveals (cascading fadeUp on cards) - All inline styles `as React.CSSProperties` - Lift exact MoatCardBright pattern from `src/components/home/work.tsx` for the anatomy cards (read it once, reuse 4 times across the 4 pages) - Reference accent map: BRAND.rust→rustWash→GRADIENT.cardRust, BRAND.amber→amberWash→cardAmber, BRAND.sage→sageWash→cardSage ## Verification After all 4 files: `cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/InkOS" && pnpm run type-check`. Report PASS or paste errors. WRITE THE 4 FILES NOW.
